title: Estimated values round (distance 100, hours 10); a rate reads as an accrual
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View customers, on the build under test.
  2. An asset is enrolled on a schedule with a mileage-triggered service and has a mileage reading history (e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab (the same estimate shows on the worklist and the work-order panel).
custom_steps:
1. Read an estimated distance and an estimated hours value.
  2. Read a recorded reading.
  3. Read how the rate is expressed.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Estimated distance rounds to the nearest 100 and estimated hours to the nearest 10.
  • A recorded reading is shown exactly as entered.
  • A rate reads as an accrual without naming a unit, for example '640 a week' (the word mileage does not appear on a speculative rate).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10568 (S11, Rate, estimate and confidence); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S11; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R12: “Estimated distance will round to the nearest 100 and estimated hours to the nearest 10. A recorded reading is shown exactly as entered”
  • S11-R18: “A rate will read as an accrual without naming a unit, for example `640 a week`. The word mileage describes a unit's history, not a speculative rate, so it does not appear here”
